findings.evidence: data/sector_market/manifest.json: provenance.data and source URLs; benchmark.json: source_record and benchmark_proxy_limit.
findings.suggestion: Name Yahoo Finance public chart adjusted-close data, collected 2026-10-17, with all eleven ticker requests retained in the manifest. Name State Street official product pages for ETF identity. Cite Fidelity Q3 p.2 for the 2026-06-30 S&P500 sector weights. Explain that ETF caps, fees and tracking error mean the resulting sleeve basket does not exactly replicate the index. These are data citations, not new paper-derived assumptions.
